wikipediaRead.title: ダマスカス
wikipediaRead.locator: 地理節 lines 389–397; ancient city identification
wikipediaRead.supportJa: 記事は現代のダマスカスと城壁内の古代都市を区別して説明しています。本文の「ダマスコ」という都市名と地域名用法は区別します。

primaryWitnesses.text: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the LORD’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

primaryWitnesses.text: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May the LORD look at it, and repay it.”
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and the LORD delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.

primaryWitnesses.text: Therefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.

primaryWitnesses.text: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against the LORD, this same King Ahaz.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of the LORD’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: ダマスコは16:2でベン・ハダドの居住地、24:23・28:5は行き先、28:23はダマスコの神々を指す表現。28:23も地名を含むが都市住民を直接述べないため場所の関連用例として保持。
シリア軍はユダとエルサレムを攻め、戦利品をダマスコの王へ送ります。
アハズはシリア王の手に渡され、多くの捕虜がダマスコへ連れ去られます。
アハズは、彼を打ち負かしたと考えたダマスコの神々に犠牲をささげます。
